items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: That's what you called him's nephew. ... A guitar player from up there away. ... That's who it looked like to me ... Little Ellie.

ctx.x: Emmett Scott was a guitar player. Yeah, like you said before. It's Ellie. That's what you called him's nephew.
A guitar player from up there away. Oh, what is his name? That's who it looked like to me because he had a horn like that and played, you see? Little Ellie.
But they don't say on there.
